name: omp-code
description: Claude Code-style chat GUI in the sidebar, backed by the omp (oh-my-pi) CLI over RPC. Supports custom model providers and the Anthropic Cloud API.

commands.title: OMP Code: Set Anthropic API Key
OMP Code: Set Kimi (Moonshot) API Key
OMP Code: Sign in with Claude (Subscription)
OMP Code: Sign in with Kimi Code (Subscription)

ompcode.ompPath.description: Path to the omp CLI binary (oh-my-pi). Defaults to `omp` resolved via PATH (~/.bun/bin is added automatically).

ompcode.customProviders.markdownDescription: Custom model providers, same shape as the `providers:` map in `~/.omp/agent/models.yml`. Merged into models.yml before each agent start. Example: `{"akemi": {"baseUrl": "http://host:8000/v1", "api": "openai-completions", "apiKey": "sk-...", "models": [{"id": "akemi-1", "name": "Akemi", "contextWindow": 128000, "maxTokens": 32000}]}}`

ompcode.defaultModel.markdownDescription: Model to select after the agent starts, as `provider/modelId` (fuzzy matched), e.g. `akemi/akemi-1` or `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`. Empty = keep the agent's default.

ompcode.thinkingLevel.description: Thinking (reasoning) level applied after the agent starts.

enumDescriptions: Auto-approve reads; ask before writes and commands.
ompcode.approvalMode.description: Tool approval mode passed to omp as --approval-mode.
